titleEn: Asking for and giving a clear update
explanationAr: عندما تطلب آخر الأخبار في العمل، كن واضحًا: Could you give me an update on the tank work? وعندما تعطي تحديثًا، استخدم المضارع التام لما أُنجز (We have finished the foundation)، والمضارع المستمر لما يجري الآن (We are installing the pipes)، و will أو going to لما سيأتي. واذكر الأرقام والتواريخ.
explanationEn: When you ask for news at work, be clear: Could you give me an update on the tank work? When you give an update, use the present perfect for what is done (We have finished the foundation), the present continuous for what is happening now (We are installing the pipes), and will or going to for what comes next. Give numbers and dates.

comparison.noteAr: ما أُنجز حتى الآن: have finished.

comparison.en: We are installing the pipes now.

examples.en: Could you give me a quick update on the project?
examples.ar: هل يمكنك أن تعطيني تحديثًا سريعًا عن المشروع؟

examples.en: We have finished 60% of the excavation.
We are waiting for the steel delivery.
We will start the next phase on Sunday.

exercises.prompt: Could you give me an update ___ the pump station?
We ___ (finish) the foundation. Now we are building the walls.
exercises.explanationAr: ما أُنجز حتى الآن: have finished.

exercises.prompt: Right now, the team ___ the new valves.
exercises.explanationAr: Right now تدل على ما يجري الآن: is installing.

exercises.sentence: We are finish the report now.
accepted: We are finishing the report now.
exercises.explanationAr: بعد are نستخدم الفعل مع ing: finishing.
will + الفعل ثم المفعول ثم الوقت.

exercises.prompt: What is the status ___ the electrical work?

exercises.sentence: Until now we didn't receive the steel.
accepted: We have not received the steel yet.
We haven't received the steel yet.
exercises.explanationAr: لحدث لم يقع حتى الآن نستخدم المضارع التام مع yet.
